description:
The animated electrician school — from your first day as an apprentice to your journeyman card.

Every lesson is built the way a good journeyman teaches: what's actually happening in the wire, why the code says what it says, and what it looks like on a real job. Clean animated diagrams, no fluff, no shaky phone footage of a panel.

The plan:
• Fundamentals — electricity from zero, properly explained
• Residential Wiring — what's inside the walls and why
• Code & Exam Prep — NEC, load calcs, and your journeyman test
• The Trade — tools, job sites, licensing, and how to actually get in

New lesson every week. Watch in order, or jump to what you need.

Educational content only. Electrical work can injure or kill — always de-energize and verify, and hire a licensed electrician for work in your home.
